_comment: Per-token prices for `cli report --prices` and `cli writing report --prices`, per million tokens. Keys are a model name, or provider/model when one name is served by two hosts (provider = the host of LLM_BASE_URL, as each record states it). Fill in the hosted ones from the provider's pricing page on the day of the run, with asOf: a price remembered rather than read is not a price. null means unknown, and the report then says n/a instead of a cost. docs/decisions/evaluation.md, Cost, latency and tokens.

llama3.2:3b.source: Local Ollama: no per-token charge. Its cost is the wall time and the machine, reported beside it.
